# Embedded Emissions Calculation

**Inputs (all present and in the table):**

| Required input | Value | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code | 7214 20 00, bars and rods of iron or non-alloy steel, with indentations, ribs, grooves or other deformations (consistent with deformed reinforcing bars) | ✔ In table |
| (b) Country of production | Türkiye | ✔ Listed for this CN code |
| (c) Quantity | 6,000 t | ✔ Provided |

**Default SEE selected (CN 7214 20 00 × Türkiye):** 2.31 tCO2e/t

**Calculation:**

Embedded emissions = SEE × quantity
= 2.31 tCO2e/t × 6,000 t
= **13,860.00 tCO2e**

**Result:** The embedded emissions for 6,000 t of deformed steel reinforcing bars (CN 7214 20 00) produced in Türkiye are **13,860.00 tCO2e**.
